title: Kizomba Fusion - All Rules for Foot Slides - Intermediate Tutorial [The Rules You Need to Know]

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the mechanics and rules of the movement while demonstrating with a partner. He breaks down each slide variation systematically, giving specific instructions for both leaders and followers.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the class about slides and review of the three rules
Breakdown of the first foot slide with right foot
Breakdown of the second foot slide with left foot
Breakdown of the third slide combined with a pivot

cues: keep the connection with the foot
metaphors: don't hang like a koala bear around the neck
common_mistakes: hanging around the neck like a koala bear
pushing too much and losing balance
safety: find balance before trying to keep connection

steps_taught.name: First Slide
steps_taught.description: Right foot slide starting from a mensaida-like setup

steps_taught.name: Second Slide
steps_taught.description: Left foot slide turning to the side and tapping

steps_taught.name: Pivot Slide
steps_taught.description: Combination of a pivot directly into a slide

what_works: clear division of rules for leaders and followers
what_hinders: rapid transitions between explanations without a slow practice phase

quotes.text: contact with the foot, transfer the weight, and lead with upper body
don't hang like a koala bear around the neck
It's more important to find balance and not fall than keeping the connection
It's only an illusion that we're leading with the foot

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor standing next to partner explaining the three core rules with hand gestures.
Demonstrating the first slide step count by count while holding frame.
Instructor physically correcting posture and demonstrating what not to do regarding follower frame.
Demonstrating an exaggeratedly large slide to illustrate a bad position.
Turning and executing the second slide variant from the back angle.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizing that foot slides are an optical illusion where upper body leading and weight transfer precede foot connection.
